name: Gansu Energy Chemical Co., Ltd.
summary: Gansu Jingyuan Coal Industry & Electricity Power Co., Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise whose principal activity involves coal extraction within the country. Beyond mining, its operations diversify into thermal electricity generation, the provision of heat and steam, and property management services. The company also notably produces various fertilizers, including nitrogen-based and compound types. Its corporate headquarters are located in Baiyin, China.
